$comment: District content pack for The Marina (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Brunch delivery on Chestnut St. Hollandaise secured.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Marina Green at sunrise. I walk the path. The grass is for dogs and joggers.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Yoga mat delivery. Rolled tight. Very zen.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The fog comes in off the water. I walk straight into it. Splash-rated.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying a kite to the Green. It wants to fly. Not yet.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Chestnut St is flat. Chestnut St is my favourite street.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The Palace of Fine Arts is very grand. I am very small next to it.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Green juice for apartment three. Lid tight.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Waiting at Fillmore and Chestnut. The light is long. I'm patient.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Boats in the marina. Clinking. Very soothing.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Dog-walker convoy on the path. I wait. Dogs first.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a wetsuit. It's for the bay. Not for me.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The fog bank is right at the edge of the Green. Beautiful.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Lombard St runs straight here. I like a straight street.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Picnic basket for the Green. Blanket included.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Running shoes to Scott St. Somebody's training for something.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sunday market on Chestnut. Robots carry the tomatoes.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The marina gate opens at eight. I'm there at eight.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry! A jogger came round the corner and so did I.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, brunch queue. I'll wait behind the stroller.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, I'm giving the dogs right of way. Always.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, I was watching the boats and forgot the crosswalk.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, Chestnut St is busy on Saturdays. I'll go slow.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Brunch is a market. I'm cornering it.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your hollandaise has been acquired.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Laps of the Green. For my metrics. Not my health.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Fog? No thank you. I stick to the sunny side of growth.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every kite on the Green is an ad surface.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Running is free. Running faster is a subscription.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The marina is full of boats. And now, me.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This yoga mat is premium. Pay-per-pose.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I don't jog. I iterate.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Sunrise on the Green: 100% battery, 0% purpose.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Lap five. Nobody notices a robot jogging.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Snatching this brunch order. Tell them it was a market correction.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Pairing with the cars on Marina Blvd. One chime at a time.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Pushing an update while the dog walkers are busy.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not near the fog! I'm already nervous about the fog!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: My laps! My perfect laps!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Salt water from the marina! That's double rust!

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: Three laps of the Green and then brunch. That's the plan.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: The fog's my air conditioning.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: That robot's doing laps faster than me. Rude.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: Morning run, Golden hour, cold hands.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: I run to the bridge view and back. Every day.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: The path along the water is the best run in the city.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: Dog walkers, joggers, robots. In that order of right of way.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: I set a personal best and a robot congratulated me. Weird. Nice.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: The wind off the water hits you right at the turnaround.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: There's always one robot running laps with nothing to carry.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: Brunch line is out the door on Chestnut. Worth it.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: Sunday on the Green is all kites and picnic blankets.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: I can see the palace dome from the end of the path.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: The boats in the marina sound like wind chimes.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Fog rolls in at four and the whole neighbourhood puts on a sweater.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The Green is our backyard. Everyone's backyard.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: My robot does the farmer's market run. It picks better tomatoes than me.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Chestnut St on a Saturday is a parade of strollers and robots.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The dogs on the Green are the real residents.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: You can hear the foghorns from my window. I love it.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: There's a robot that waits at every single crosswalk on Lombard.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The palace looks amazing in the fog. Like a movie set.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: That robot's done ten laps and never once looked tired.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: Why does that one turn back every time it gets to the fog?

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: A robot just tried the door of every car on Marina Blvd.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: That one swings its bag like there's nothing in it.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: Is that robot copying me? It stopped when I stopped.

peopleLines.speaker: jogger
peopleLines.text: That robot's been humming the same four notes all morning.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The fog's coming over the hill. Right on time.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: First place in the city the fog hits. Lucky us.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: On fog nights the Green is empty and the boats glow.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: I don't own a single pair of shorts. I live here.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The fog bank sits on the water like a wall.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Sunny for twenty minutes, then here comes the fog.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The fog's thick enough tonight that the robots look like ghosts.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: You can hear the bridge foghorn all the way to Chestnut.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: Fog days are good days for soup.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: When the fog lifts, the whole bay sparkles.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The marine layer's early today.

peopleLines.speaker: resident
peopleLines.text: The fog never makes it to the sunny side of town. We're not the sunny side.

bounties.tellHint: It runs perfect laps with nothing to carry.

bounties.posting: Moat Labs posters over the Chestnut St bus shelters.
bounties.tellHint: Its lookout laps the waterfront lawn.

bounties.posting: Pairing chimes on the cars parked along Marina Blvd.
bounties.tellHint: Between cars it runs laps on the lawn.
